title: KD-Tree: build, nearest, radius search
hints: Don't move points around: sort an index array `idx_` and let every node own a range [begin, end) of it.
Split axis = depth % 3 (or the axis with the largest spread). Median in O(n) with `std::nth_element` on the index range, comparing `pts_[i][axis]`.
Store nodes in a flat `std::vector<Node>` with child indices; stop splitting when a range has ≤ ~8 points (leaf bucket).
Search: recurse into the child on q's side first; visit the far child only if `diff*diff < best_d2` where `diff = q[axis] - split` (use `<=` and r² for radius search).
